title: Review short-ball decisions
tip: Review when you choose to pull, hook, evade or defend against short bowling. The recorded dismissals do not establish a particular mechanical fault.
drill: In a supervised net session, mix shorter and fuller feeds and practise deciding whether to attack or leave each delivery.

title: Practise selection outside off stump
tip: Review which outside-off deliveries you attack and which you can leave, considering your match format.
drill: Use an off-stump reference in the nets and alternate leave, defence and controlled-drive decisions with feedback from a coach.

title: Review responses to fuller deliveries
tip: Review balance, bat presentation and shot choice when facing fuller deliveries; the data alone cannot diagnose footwork.
drill: Practise controlled straight-bat responses to mixed full-length and yorker feeds under supervision.

title: Review lofted-shot selection
tip: Review the delivery, field and match situation before choosing an aerial shot.
drill: Alternate grounded and aerial targets in the nets and discuss the selection decision after each feed.

title: Review scoring options against spin
tip: Review length recognition and your scoring options against the recorded spin type. Frequent dismissals do not by themselves establish that spin is a weakness.
drill: Use varied spin feeds to practise defending, rotating strike and attacking selected lengths with a coach's feedback.

title: Review running and communication
tip: Review calling, partner communication and decisions on marginal runs in the recorded run-outs.
drill: Practise clear yes/no/wait calls and turning between wickets with a partner.

title: Review dismissals that hit the stumps
tip: Review the length, line and shot choice in bowled dismissals with a coach before attributing them to a technical issue.
drill: Practise controlled straight-bat defence against varied lines and lengths, checking balance and bat path with feedback.

title: Review LBW dismissal decisions
tip: Review the delivery line, movement and your response in LBW dismissals with a coach.
drill: Practise identifying stump-threatening deliveries and selecting an appropriate straight-bat response.
